comments.value: This is badly needed yea, glitched, falling, moving etc is extremely annoying when you wanna try to get out of it but your menu just wont react.
@{5a4169d823f6da7b8133d860|full_name}: hey at least the menu still works on low fps, unlike the people selector

@{5a4169d823f6da7b8133d860|full_name}: sure, the menu isnt usable when you fall, but you have to appreciate how usable it still is considering the image loading delay at the game start, the broken user selection at low fps and the tile disintegration after some time, it still kinda works ok at its core and that is fine.

I was just about to suggest having the main menu follow the avatar so it doesn't get left behind. It would be really appreciated rather than having to force quit VRChat and relaunch because you can't access the menu whilst you are on the move. (e.g. you are on a ride that isn't ending anytime soon)

@{5d627106a6f211386af23bfe|full_name}: Thats not the point of this request.
Point of this request is that there is a problem that should be fixed cause it traps players in quite a few situations that we simply cannot get out of.
I think the new action menu works while moving, they should make the same for this menu.

Alt-F4 squad! 
Jokes aside, I've been in worlds where the respawn glitched, dropping me beneath the world and forcing me to take off my HMD and force-exit the client. As someone who gets very immersed into the VR world, this can be quite a nuisance, and with the social aspect of the game (I was doing a puzzle map with friends, and most of us had the same glitch), it's doubly important to me to not have to exit the game even due to bugs.

comments.mergedPostDetails: If you fall, or get launched by an object in VR, you cannot access the quick menu to (for example): Respawn, check invites, change settings, etc. The biggest concern here is respawning as some worlds can take a long time to get back to surface level.
comments.mergedPostTitle: Quick Menu cannot be accessed when maintaining velocity

comments.value:
Ever been to a world with the Spawn Point is placed right over top of a Portal that would lead you back to the same world in a loop? 
*Loads World, Spawns to World only to find out that your falling and into a Portal right below you. Oh my! *

As of a recent update, you can use your Quick Menu while moving quickly.
There still appears to be a velocity at which your menu will stop working well, but it is very, very high.
This is great I appreciate how much VRChat is now changing and evolving it is awesome @{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name} lets keep this going !

details: This should have been added from the start to be honest, it's kinda annoying whenever you get glitched into the air really high by a chair or something of the sort and have to wait like 5 minutes to fall back down to the world or you have to spam the respawn button hoping it hits, pleeeeaaaaaase add this in eventually in the near future I beg you
title: Useable menu while moving or falling
